Class PlayerStats

java.lang.Object
app.PlayerStats
public class PlayerStats extends Object
Stores and updates the player's social battery and social standing.

Both stats are stored as values from 0.0 to 1.0. Dialogue choices can increase or decrease these values, and the values are clamped so they stay within the valid range.

  • Method Details

    • changeStats

      public boolean changeStats(int optionType)
      Updates player stats based on the chosen dialogue option.

      Option 1 decreases social battery and increases social standing. Option 2 increases social battery and decreases social standing. Option 3 decreases both values.

      Parameters:
      optionType - the selected dialogue option number
      Returns:
      true if the updated stats cause a game-over condition, false otherwise
